newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen flat or down on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen flat or down on Monday.

text.p: Polish shares were seen flat to down on Monday as demand would remain low before the public offer of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz SA starting next week.

But analysts said good economic data such as the Central Statistical Office's (GUS) Friday statement that the economy should continue to grow fast in the second quarter after 7.3 percent growth in the first should keep the market relatively flat.
They said Mostostal Export could be helped by Friday's news it signed a 160-million-zloty contract.
